# Corpus dữ liệu HỢP LỆ — mỗi dòng: "<ctx> <giá trị>" (tách ở dấu cách ĐẦU TIÊN, phần sau giữ nguyên văn).
# ctx: all       = không được có finding ở MỌI ngữ cảnh (text, URL, strict)
#      text      = không được có finding ở ngữ cảnh text (URL / strict được phép bắt)
#      nonstrict = không được có finding ở text và URL (strict được phép bắt)

# --- URL thật ---
all https://shop.example.com/products/ao-thun-nam?variant=4012345678&utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=sale_50%25
all https://shop.example.com/collections/all?page=2&sort_by=price-ascending
all https://shop.example.com/search?q=size+%3C+10
all https://shop.example.com/search?q=%E1%BA%A3o+kho%C3%A1c
all https://shop.example.com/pages/about#team
all https://shop.example.com/products/x?fbclid=IwAR1aBcDeFgHiJkLmNoPqRsTuVwXyZ_0123456789
all https://shop.example.com/products/x?variant=1&_pos=1&_sid=abc&_ss=r
all https://shop.example.com/products/x?q=%3C3
all https://shop.example.com/cart/c/Z2NwLXVzLWVhc3QxOjAxSjBGRjQ0?key=abc
all //cdn.example.com/s/files/1/0001/image.jpg?v=1700000000
all shop.example.com
all gid://shopify/Product/1234567890

# --- chữ tự do có ký tự đặc biệt ---
all Size < 10
all I <3 NY
all 5 > 3 and 2 < 4
all a<b
all x<y>z
all a < b > c
all x -> y
all <-- back
all Value <= 5
all price >= 100 && price <= 200
all Ultra-fast <24h delivery
all Kids 3-5 yrs <3 years warranty
all Áo khoác <M>
all Giảm giá 50% hôm nay!
all 50% off — only today
all 100%
all 🔥 Flash Sale 🔥 -30%
all 👨‍👩‍👧 Family pack
all Summer Sale (2026) – Buy 1 Get 1
all "Best seller" product
all It's a 'great' deal
all He said "on demand"
all Ref: ORDER#1001; Note: giao trước 5h
all Tom &amp; Jerry
all Tom & Jerry
all C:\Users\shop\file.csv
all SELECT * FROM products
all data: 2026-10-30
all metadata: x
all javascripts are great
all Learn Java: Script edition

# --- dạng key=value / JSON trong giá trị ---
all online=1
all one=two&three=four
all only=yes
all the onion=good
all Lemon=fresh
all {"a":1,"b":[1,2,"x"]}
all [{"id":"123","quantity":2}]
all ^/admin/(foo|bar)$

# --- định danh / hash ---
all fb.1.1700000000000.AbCdEfGhIjKl
all fb.1.1700000000000.IwAR1aBcDeFg
all a3f1c2e4b5d6978899aabbccddeeff00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff00
all +84 912 345 678
all john.doe+tag@example.com
all c1-ab12cd34ef56
all 9007199254740993

# --- chỉ hợp lệ ở text (URL/strict được phép bắt) ---
text JavaScript: The Good Parts
text javascript: a beginner guide

# --- hợp lệ ở text + URL, strict được phép bắt (biểu thức template) ---
nonstrict {{ product.title }}
nonstrict Use ${price} in template
nonstrict Hello {{name}}
